title: The oldest jewelry is 142,000 years old

hook.text: The oldest jewelry is 142,000 years old.

end.line: A new jewelry story every day

lines.text: The oldest jewelry is 142,000 years old.
lines.say: The oldest jewelry is one hundred forty-two thousand years old.

lines.text: In a Moroccan cave, archaeologists found 33 shells with holes in them.
lines.say: In a Moroccan cave, archaeologists found thirty-three shells with holes in them.

lines.text: Wear around the holes suggests the shells hung from strings or clothes.
Some shells still carry traces of red ochre.
The sea is under ten miles away, so people carried them there.
A mineral crust over them dates to about 142,000 years ago,
lines.say: A mineral crust over them dates to about one hundred forty-two thousand years ago,

lines.text: so the beads are at least that old.
The old record was beads from Israel, up to 135,000 years old.
lines.say: The old record was beads from Israel, up to one hundred thirty-five thousand years old.

lines.text: Researchers think people wore them to show who they were.

post.caption: Archaeologists found 33 sea snail shells with holes in Bizmoune Cave in Morocco. A mineral crust over them is about 142,000 years old, so they are the oldest shell beads known. Researchers think people wore them to show who they were.
